title: Approximate search recall against an exact reference
method: Synthetic200 queries with one exact-neighbor reference each. Recovery170/200=85%,190/200=95%,200/200=100%. This measures index approximation, not semantic relevance or answer correctness. Invented median latencies20,35,80ms are discussed separately.
alt: Approximate search recall against an exact reference. Fast approximate: 170 queries, Thorough approximate: 190 queries, Exact reference: 200 queries. Illustrative data.
